raw:
Retrieval-augmented assertion generation: it retrieves a similar focal-test and its assertion, then a neural model edits that assertion. The generator conditions on the retrieved text, so this is a RAG-style system. The paper runs experiments on two datasets and proposes a new method, so it meets the inclusion criteria. The one doubt is whether a retrieve-and-edit approach counts as an LM conditioning on retrieved documents. It likely does, since the retrieved assertion is given to the editing model. INCLUDE.
